metadata.title: Cross-platform transfer of blood gene-expression models in Parkinson's disease — permutation and CBC operational amendment
metadata.description:
Combined amendment v3.1.4-permutation-cbc, in the existing concept DOI lineage 10.5281/zenodo.23405370. Author: Mohammad Javad Asgari, ORCID 0009-0002-2313-571X.

This amendment is published after the observed GEO development results and before any registered randomized GEO permutation, CBC association or PPMI disease score. It fixes B=200 M4/M5 repetitions over ten within-source outer folds, with coherent donor-level label maps, full label-dependent retuning, immutable seeds, resumable checkpoints and the existing numerical rules. The same-participant, any-visit, same-calendar-month CBC rule is fixed before marker completeness or associations are inspected; per-marker n below 30 is non-evaluable and does not reopen matching. Approximately 30 valid pairs provide limited supportive evidence only.

The final Linux preflight passed all 33 synthetic checks (650 fit attempts, maximum KKT 2.684e-8), all 20 observed-GEO identity comparisons (zero AUROC error; maximum probability error 7.65e-14), eight-worker/two-thread resource checks and zero swapout growth. The tested environment is Python 3.11.9 with the exact locked packages on a 16-vCPU x86_64 Linux VM. This microbenchmark does not establish full permutation runtime.

The supplied files contain the English amendment, frozen executor/config/environment, aggregate preflight certificate and immutable release manifest. No PPMI participant data, sample-level GEO inputs/predictions, fitted models or credentials are included. The passing binding SHA-256 is 4be7bd1bc5e92da5d094fc6f59dbd45df033b254b3dc31043b4af8ed1ccc0310.

This release changes the exploratory permutation control and CBC operational date rule only. It does not change the confirmatory PPMI endpoint. The first randomized execution after publication is registered replicate 0 at one worker; subsequent concurrency may be 1, 2, 4 or 8 within the tested ceiling. The original protocol and earlier amendments remain governing except for these explicitly documented changes.
